name: mt_bench_ppl_random
description: A dataset/benchmark measuring language model perplexity on machine translation (MT) data sampled randomly (PPL = perplexity). It evaluates how well language models assign likelihoods to MT-style text distributions, providing a measure of model fluency and fit to MT corpora. The benchmark is primarily used to compare probabilistic scoring (perplexity) across models and settings.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face used in research on MT perplexity; limited but useful for language-model scoring comparisons.
